Duplicate patients possible if multiple Examination records exist. Distinct policy needed.

join_paths.purpose: Link examination findings (thrombosis severity) to patient demographic and diagnostic information

accepted_draft.data_grain: Examination record level driven by Thrombosis filter, requiring deduplication to Patient level for final output
relationship_risks: One-to-many relationship between Patient and Examination tables may cause duplicate patient rows if a patient has multiple examination records meeting the filter criteria.
Semantic ambiguity in 'severe degree': Knowledge defines '1' as most severe and '2' as severe. Query wording 'severe degree' may map to value 2 exclusively or include 1.
